brief_summary: This trial is conducted in Indonesia. The aim of the trial is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of BGM0504 versus semaglutide as add-on to metformin in patients with type 2 diabetes
brief_title: A Study of BGM0504 in Participants With Type 2 Diabetes in Indonesia
official_title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Open Label Trial Comparing Efficacy and Safety of BGM0504 Versus Semaglutide Once Weekly as Add-on Therapy to Metformin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c)
